watch.en: Use plenty of water at a rapid boil and add all the pasta at once.
watch.de: Reichlich sprudelnd kochendes Wasser nehmen und alle Nudeln auf einmal hineingeben.

why.en: Pasta takes up salt while it cooks; salt added afterwards does not season it in the same way.
why.de: Nudeln nehmen das Salz beim Kochen auf; nachträglich zugegebenes Salz würzt nicht auf dieselbe Weise.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products, section Boiling
sources.sentence: The water should be brought to a rapid boil, then all the pasta should be added at once.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products, section Boiling
sources.sentence: Adding salt to the pasta after it is cooked will not provide the same seasoning effect.
